scripts.dev:prd: doppler run -c prd --mount .env -- bunx wrangler dev --port 3000
scripts.deploy: doppler run -c prd --mount .env -- bunx wrangler secret bulk .env && bunx wrangler deploy
scripts.db:push: doppler run -- env DOTENV_CONFIG_PATH=/dev/null bun --no-env-file x --bun --no-install drizzle-kit push
scripts.db:push:prod: doppler run -c prd -- env DOTENV_CONFIG_PATH=/dev/null bun --no-env-file x --bun --no-install drizzle-kit push
scripts.db:studio: doppler run -- env DOTENV_CONFIG_PATH=/dev/null bun --no-env-file x --bun --no-install drizzle-kit studio
scripts.db:studio:prod: doppler run -c prd -- env DOTENV_CONFIG_PATH=/dev/null bun --no-env-file x --bun --no-install drizzle-kit studio
